title: Trash
whyItMatters: Deleted files sit in the Trash until it is emptied. A handover can pass on documents the owner thought they had removed.
source: Apple macOS User Guide, delete files (items move to the Trash); per-user Trash is the ~/.Trash folder (Unconfirmed: no Apple page names the path)
notes: TCC-protected: without Full Disk Access a live scan gets a permission skip. Items are counted by metadata; per-volume .Trashes folders are out of scope. Reviewed in W3-D2 (independent review, docs/research/macos-review.md).
